text: And in this, took my life to write the rhyme But I'm recording it, quit If it is, then just let it be It's quantum physics when I spit it Me and sixes got that chemistry Shorty asked me what I do with my life I said I sleep, paint, smoke, and then I move through the night Fake hustlers, they ain't moving it right But when I spit it from the soul, you feel it move through the mic My people ask me what you do in the night Me and sixes in the lab until the music is tight
